verses: Push not the cart you stand behind;— You'll only raise the dust. Nor dwell On your anxieties of mind;— You'll only make yourself unwell.
Push not the cart you stand behind;— The dust will only blind your view. Dwell not on things that vex your mind;— You never thus can see them true.
Push not the cart you stand behind;— The dust will but becloud your eyes. Heed not the troubles of your mind;— 'Twill weight you as you seek to rise.
